newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania pig numbers up, cattle down in January.
newsitem.headline: Romania pig numbers up, cattle down in January.

text.p: Romania's pig herds increased in the year to end-January as private sector numbers rose, National Statistics Board (CNS) data showed on Friday.
A CNS report showed the number of pigs had risen by around 102,000 to 8.2 million at the end of January.
But cattle were 67,000 down to 3.5 million and sheep and goat numbers declined by around 773,000 to 10.9 million.
Data showed the private sector held 90.7 percent of cattle, 58.1 percent of pigs and 92.6 percent of sheep and goats.
